text:
security-oncall: 🚨 Heads up: CVE-2026-2847 (containerd shim escape) is now reported exploited in the wild. advisory: https://example.test/CVE-2026-2847 - unauth local container breakout via shim exec plugin.

mari: ack, on it. which images/clusters do we run containerd shim in?

jacob: our hosted inference control plane uses containerd 1.7 on dedicated nodes in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. also some private deployments run older 1.6 variants.

liam: quick triage: exploit requires local untrusted container exec to reach shim socket. attack vector = attacker with container exec access.

security-oncall: severity = CRITICAL (exploit in the wild + SCOPE=host), CVSS 9.1 in advisory. immediate mitigation recommended.

mari: mitigation options: 1) pinch privileges on host: `chmod 660 /run/containerd/containerd.sock` + restrict group membership 2) ensure CRI plugin permissions 3) upgrade containerd to patched release 1.7.5+ or apply backport patch.

jacob: can we apply a hotfix on hosted nodes tonight? rollout window open 22:00-02:00 UTC.

liam: we should prefer upgrade over perms if possible. but perms + RBAC mitigations give faster coverage for private tenants.

security-oncall: plan proposal: step A (now): apply host-level mitigation (socket perms + audit rules) across hosted fleet; step B (next 24h): staged OS image + containerd upgrade on canaries; step C (48h): full fleet patch and customer comms.

mari: agree. I'll push an orchestration job to set socket perms and add auditd syscall watch for `connect` to containerd socket.

jacob: add to runbook: `sudo chown root:containerd /run/containerd/containerd.sock && sudo chmod 660 /run/containerd/containerd.sock` then systemd restart `systemctl restart containerd`.

liam: add audit rule: `-a always,exit -F path=/run/containerd/containerd.sock -S connect -k ctrd-sock` so we can detect suspicious access.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for job `security/mitigate/cd-socket-perms` (pipeline id 785412).

mari: patching private deployments — we need to surface upgrade guidance for customers with air-gapped environments. drafting instructions now.

product-ops: tagging affected customers: ded-dev, bankcorp-prod, medai-ops. product-ops will open tickets and flag for SOC.

security-oncall: KMS/RBAC note: rotating node service account keys won't stop exploit but reduces lateral access if host creds were exfiltrated. schedule KMS key rotation only after we confirm no successful breakout.

liam: also recommend tightening node RBAC: revoke `docker`/`containerd` group access from CI runners and ephemeral builders until patch applied.

mari: I've started a canary upgrade on 3 nodes in eu-west-1 (node ids: i-0a1, i-0b2, i-0c3). will monitor for any regressions.

jacob: add probe: synthetic job that attempts `nsenter` style container exec with limited permissions to validate socket perms.

mari: logs so far: canaries healthy. no crashes. deploy-bot shows `785412` succeeded on canaries.

security-oncall: comms: draft incident advisory for customers and SOC. include mitigation steps, ETA for full patch, and detection query for SIEM.

comms: I'll draft external advisory. short timeline and recommended immediate steps for self-hosted customers.

mari: detection SIGQL for SIEM: `event.type:connect AND path:'/run/containerd/containerd.sock' AND user.name:!=root` — flag suspicious non-root connects.

liam: for RBAC change, patch CI user role to remove `hostExec` perm. I'll open PR to infra-iam.

jacob: can we automate patching for Dedicated customers? we have reserved capacity nodes; ops can schedule upgrades with zero-downtime rolling. ops-team assigned.

security-oncall: escalation: if we confirm exploit success on a host, we will enact emergency node reprovision + KMS key rotation + customer contact.

mari: checklist items I'm pushing to runbook: 1) socket perms job 2) auditd rule 3) canary containerd upgrade 4) fleet upgrade job 5) RBAC restriction PR 6) SIEM detection rule 7) customer advisory draft

deploy-bot: pipeline `security/upgrade/containerd-canary` (id 785423) started.

jacob: note for private/offline installs: provide backported packaged binaries and patch script: `install-containerd-patch.sh --version 1.7.5-patch`. mari pls attach to ticket.

mari: attaching patch instructions to ticket now.

security-oncall: timeline update: host-mitigation rollout started (T+10m), canary upgrades green (T+45m). full fleet expected finished in <36h barring issues.

comms: external advisory ready for review. sharing in #legal-comms and will post after sec approval.

liam: monitoring: added Grafana dashboard for `containerd_socket_connects` + alert `HighNonRootSocketConnects > 5m` -> pager to sec-oncall.

mari: all right. continuing rollout. ping here with any regressions. :thumbsup:

security-oncall: thanks all. keep this thread for final postmortem notes. moving to incidents channel for cross-team coordination if we see confirmed breaches.

deploy-bot: pipeline `security/mitigate/cd-socket-perms` (id 785412) finished: succeeded on 120/120 hosts.

mari: final update (T+20h): fleet upgrade 1.7.5 applied to hosted nodes, private-customer outreach in progress. closing initial response, will open postmortem in 48h.

security-oncall: closing here; follow-up PM: schedule postmortem, include timeline, detection gaps, and RBAC policy improvements.
